segments.name: Merchant Solutions
segments.description: Provides payment acceptance, transaction processing and gateway solutions to small and medium sized merchants and integrated service providers, mainly in North America and Europe.
segments.evidence: The Merchant Solutions segment services markets primarily in North America, Canada and Europe.

segments.name: Digital Wallets
segments.description: Offers digital wallets, pay-by-bank and prepaid cash voucher solutions so merchants and consumers can send, spend, store and accept funds online.
segments.evidence: Our proprietary digital wallet solutions are marketed under the Neteller, Skrill and PagoEfectivo brand names, as well as proprietary pay-by-bank solutions.

revenueModel.text: Merchants and consumers pay the company for payment acceptance and processing, digital wallet and online cash solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company earns revenue from the sale of Merchant Solutions and Digital Wallets services.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold substantially all assets of its direct marketing payment processing business line, Paysafe Direct, within Merchant Solutions.
changes.evidence: On February 11, 2025, the Company announced a definitive agreement to sell substantially all assets related to its direct marketing payment processing business line (Paysafe Direct, LLC) to KORT payments.
